research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Honeylove is focused on developing shaping garments that integrate slimming elastic bands. These garments feature a horizontal elastic band and a diagonal elastic band designed to reshape the inner and outer upper legs, providing a slimmer appearance and lifting effect. This research aligns with Honeylove's emphasis on combining function with fashion, as the garments aim to enhance body shape while maintaining comfort and style.

overview_description.description: Honeylove is a venture-backed DTC fashion brand founded by EDM artist Betsie Larkin. After searching high and low for quality shapewear that made her feel confident on stage, Betsie decided to create her own line of stage-worthy shapewear and launched publicly in 2018. Since then, Honeylove has expanded to tops, bras, leggings and many other garments that have set new standards in their verticals. The company grew quickly over the past couple of years and acquired a loyal customer base, as well as praise from countless influencers and publishers (eg: New York Times, Good Morning America, etc). Honeylove's approach is to apply a technical and artistic approach to problems we see with conventional garments, creating products that serve customers of all shapes, sizes, and backgrounds.
